verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party rule engine where users define event-triggered actions. Webhooks only push event notifications to the user's own application, so the user must build the actions; that is a developer building block. Card authorization controls are spend restrictions, an adjacent control rather than general event-to-action automation rules, and the spend overview's 'automate' is too vague to credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
